001: The cultural festival is next month, isn't it?
Yes, it is. We have to think of something to put on.
Has our class already decided what we're going to do?
Not yet. We need to discuss it together.
I think a haunted house would be good.
That sounds interesting. Let's definitely add it to the list of candidates.
002: Have the preparations for the sports festival already started?
Yes, our class started practicing last week.
What events are you planning to participate in?
I'm going to be in the relay and the ball-tossing game.
The relay is exciting to watch. Do your best.
Thank you. I'm counting on your support.
003: Is the poster for the school festival already finished?
Not yet. I'm in the middle of thinking about the design.
Really? That would be a big help.
What kind of image do you think the poster should have?
I think something bright and eye-catching would be good.
004: I'm looking forward to the choir contest next week.
Me too. But I'm a little nervous.
Yes, we've gotten quite a bit better.
What song are you going to sing?
A song called "Hometown." It's a very beautiful song.
005: We still haven't decided what to sell at the school festival food stall.
I think yakisoba would be good.
But the preparation might be a lot of work.
That's true. Do you have any other good ideas?
Crepes might be easy and good too.
006: I became a member of the school festival executive committee.
That must be tough. But it seems rewarding.
It is. There are all kinds of tasks, so I'm busy.
What kind of work are you doing?
Mostly managing the schedule and being the contact person.
It must be hard, but keep up the good work.
007: In the class relay at the sports festival, is our class strong?
We came in third place last year. This year we're aiming for first place.
That's impressive. Your hard work in practice is paying off.
But the other classes are strong too, so we can't let our guard down.
I'll come cheer for you on the day.
Thank you. Your support gives us strength.
008: Has it been decided what you're doing for the stage performance at the cultural festival?
Yes, we've decided to do a band performance.
Nice. What songs are you going to play?
We're going to play two songs from a popular anime.
I'll be looking forward to it.
009: The preparations for the graduation ceremony have started.
Yes. When I think that we'll be graduating soon, it makes me a little sad.
Time really does fly, doesn't it?
Are you planning any kind of performance for the graduation ceremony?
Yes, we're planning to do a slideshow of memories.
That sounds like it'll be moving. I'm looking forward to it.
010: We're thinking about what to do for the welcome party for new students.
Something that would make the new students happy would be good.
I think a quiz competition would be good.
A quiz gets people excited. That's a good idea.
About how many questions should we prepare?
I think around twenty questions would be enough.
